ONE_SENTENCE_PITCH: Generate an installable pain001 loader plugin with Cookiecutter and executable contract tests.
QUICK_START_SNIPPET:
poetry run cookiecutter . --no-input --output-dir /tmp/pain001-plugins
cd /tmp/pain001-plugins/pain001-loader-example
python -m pip install -e '.[dev]'
python -m pytest -q
python -m pain001 plugins show example
QUICK_START_EXPLANATION: The generated parser reads tab-separated text with a header. Replace that parser for your own format while retaining the loader protocol and tests.
CAPABILITY_DESCRIPTION: Entry-point packaging, streaming loader scaffold and generated tests
FEATURES_CONTENT: Preserves leading zeroes and decimal scale, rejects malformed row widths, supports bounded streaming chunks and exposes package metadata through pain001 discovery.
CONFIGURATION_CONTENT: Cookiecutter prompts for project_name, module_name, plugin_name and file_extension. Use Python identifiers for module_name and a lowercase dotted suffix for file_extension. The package starts at 0.0.1.
EXAMPLES_CONTENT: The generated ExampleLoader and tests form the worked example. See [authoring guide](docs/usage.md) for all four core extension contracts.
LIMITATIONS_CONTENT: Do not use the demonstration parser as a bank-format specification or assume plugins are sandboxed. Plugins run with the host Python process's permissions.
SECURITY_CONTENT: Review templates and plugin code before execution. Use synthetic fixtures only. The example preserves strings; it does not infer missing identifiers or monetary data. No signing or sandbox boundary is claimed. The project holds the [OpenSSF Best Practices passing badge](https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/16560).
STABILITY_CONTENT: Version 0.0.86, in lockstep with the pain001 suite. The scaffold's first tagged release was 0.0.82; each release advances with the suite by one 0.0.1 step. Generated third-party plugins retain their own initial 0.0.1 version. The core plugin contract remains pre-1.0.
ADDITIONAL_INSTALL_METHODS: Download the versioned source archive from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/sebastienrousseau/pain001-plugin-template/releases/tag/v0.0.86). This scaffold is distributed as source, not as a PyPI package.
DEMO_ALT_TEXT: Rendering the template, running the generated plugin's tests at 100% coverage, and pain001 discovering the installed loader
DEVELOPMENT_COMMANDS:
poetry install --all-extras
make check      # lint, complexity, tests at 100% coverage, README, versions
make sec        # pip-audit
make docs-lint  # codespell and markdownlint
DEVELOPMENT_CONTENT: Tests render the template, install the plugin into an isolated directory, run its own tests and lint, and check that pain001 discovers it. README changes come from docs/readme-values.json and scripts/render_readme.py; CI rejects drift. [DEVELOPMENT.md](DEVELOPMENT.md) maps every CI gate to its local command.
ECOSYSTEM_COMPARISON_SUMMARY: This is a scaffold that generates loader plugins for the core, not an alternative payment engine.
